question: Is there a Latinx or Hispanic student organization at Ramapo, and how would I get in touch with them?
answer:
Yes. The directory gives nine Student Organization listings [1]. Latinx/Hispanic-related groups include:
- Association of Latino Professionals for America — https://archway.ramapo.edu/ALPFAO/ [2]. Email alpfa@ramapo.edu. [11]
- Association of Latinos Moving Ahead (ALMA) — https://archway.ramapo.edu/ALMA/ [3]. Email alma08@ramapo.edu; everyone is welcome. [10, 13]
- Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers — https://archway.ramapo.edu/SHPES/ [4]
- Spanish Club — https://archway.ramapo.edu/SpanClub/ [5]. Email spanishclub@ramapo.edu. [12]
- Organization of Latino Unity (OLU) — https://archway.ramapo.edu/OLU/ [6]. Email olu@ramapo.edu. [14]
- Latinx Pre-Law Society — https://archway.ramapo.edu/LPLSC/ [7]
- Latino Medical Student Association PLUS — https://archway.ramapo.edu/LMSA/ [9]
For help connecting with these organizations, contact the Center for Student Involvement at csi@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7593, SC-202. [10, 13, 14] Ramapo’s culturally based organizations welcome students to connect, participate, and get involved. [17]
